$comment: DESIGN SCAFFOLD - draft shape only, not yet validated against a real implementation or test suite. Generalizes the OBSERVED SHAPE of wave-dependency-matrix.json from a separate SharePoint migration repository (wave, objectType, sourceName/destinationName, dependsOn) with zero project-specific content. dependsOn here is BY OBJECT NAME ONLY -- the source's practice of also allowing a bare wave-number string was deliberately not carried forward (see sharepoint-provisioning/scripts/wave_planning.py's module docstring for why).
title: SharePoint Migration Dependency Matrix

name.description: Unique object name, e.g. a list, content type, or field name.

objectType.description: Caller-defined free text, e.g. 'List', 'ContentType', 'SiteColumn'. Not a fixed enum.

dependsOn.description: Names of other objects in this array that must be deployed first.

waves.description: Computed by analyze-sharepoint-dependency-graph via wave_planning.plan_waves() -- not hand-authored.
